Subject: Issue: Kestrel PO can't accept — OTP arriving 6+ minutes

Hi Jordan,

We're onboarding our supplier account and trying to accept our first PO (PO# KP-3349) from Redwood's portal. The accept button is there, but the one-time password (OTP) for confirmation is taking minutes to arrive — sometimes it never does. Our team tried 6 different users across two domains; same result. This is blocking our AP team from acknowledging the PO (we're on a hard cutover deadline Thursday).

Attached is a screenshot of the error state (screenshot-otp-error.png) and our company MPA for reference. Can you confirm whether Redwood is throttling OTPs for tenant KestrelProcure or if there's an issue on our side?

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick note and the attachments. I've looped in Ben (SRE) and Marissa (Customer Success) to triage.

Initial checks:
- No global SMS provider outage reported on our side.
- There is a tenant-level throttling rule we apply when we detect repeated OTP retries to protect sending quotas — if KestrelProcure's acceptance flow generated many retries during initial tests, that could have pushed the tenant into temporary rate-limit backoff.

Can you confirm: approx how many acceptance attempts per user (or per IP) you saw, and whether your users are all behind the same NAT? Also, please share a sample timestamp and recipient phone/email so we can search logs.

We'll escalate on our side if this is blocking your cutover. Marissa — can you start a short Zoom with Samantha if we need to do live repro? Ben — can you pull the OTP delivery logs for tenant kestrelprocure (last 24h) and check for throttling/backoff events?

Jordan

> - No global SMS provider outage reported on our side.
> - There is a tenant-level throttling rule we apply when we detect repeated OTP retries to protect sending quotas — if KestrelProcure's acceptance flow generated many retries during initial tests, that could have pushed the tenant into temporary rate-limit backoff.

Hi all — I pulled logs for tenant: kestrelprocure (tenant_id: t-kestrel-88) between 2026-10-18T22:00:00Z and 2026-10-19T16:00:00Z. Findings:

- We observed an initial burst of 78 OTP attempts from one /19 IP block between 09:02 and 09:09 PDT. That triggered our tenant throttling circuit (configured to protect overall SMS throughput while we investigate patterns). The circuit imposes a progressive backoff — subsequent OTPs are delayed (queued) and can show delivery latency of several minutes.
- Later attempts were retried by your users which extended the queue time.

Action taken:
- I cleared the soft throttle for t-kestrel-88 at 11:00 PDT (manual intervention) so new OTPs should flow normally.
- I also bumped KestrelProcure's burst allowance temporarily to ensure you can finish the cutover.

Samantha — please try again now and let us know results (if you still see >60s delays include a sample recipient and timestamp). If you need immediate acceptance for a specific PO, we can also send a one-off verification link instead of OTP to bypass SMS/Email route.

Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference
